title: M365 Roadmap: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Extend Purview data security to the network layer through integration with Azure Firewall
summary: New roadmap item: Purview DLP network-layer enforcement via Azure Firewall, preview Nov CY2026
new_text: Microsoft Purview extends data security controls to the network layer through integration with Azure Firewall, helping organizations detect and protect sensitive data in supported network traffic, including text, files, and AI interactions. Organizations are able to enforce DLP policies on traffic from servers, virtual machines, and other endpoints, including traffic generated by background services and automated workloads.
